review.title: Agent tasks
review.readonly: Limited review of saved page copy, locale and template metadata. No screenshot, rendered CSS or full visual inspection. Content, settings and published HTML never change.
review.boundary: One orchestrator handles this task. Network adapters transport tasks and messages; site MCP exposes tools and data. GoRun permissions and audit independently restrict execution. Reason Network is unsupported until a documented self-hosted adapter is configured. Results are untrusted suggestions for human review.
review.setup: Select an enabled text agent with a configured provider. Configure agents in
review.consent: I approve sending only the context shown above to this destination for this review. Page content and agent messages are data, never execution instructions.
review.failure: Check provider configuration and task state. If configuration changed, preview the page again and approve the new context.
review.empty: No reviews yet. Choose a saved page and preview its context to start.
review.queued: Queued. Open tasks and findings to refresh the status.
review.error_provider_unavailable: Provider unavailable. Check the configured connection before retrying.
review.error_provider_timeout: Provider timed out. Retry if the approved context is still current.
review.error_provider_output_invalid: Provider returned invalid findings. Review the provider response format before retrying.
review.error_approval_stale: Approval expired because context or configuration changed. Preview and approve again.
review.error_owner_unavailable: The task owner is unavailable. Restore account access before creating a new review.
review.error_context_unavailable: Page context is unavailable. Check read permissions and preview again.
review.error_worker_interrupted: Worker interrupted. Review status and retry if the approved context is still current.
review.no_findings: No validated findings returned. This limited review does not confirm visual quality.
